title: 第19章 善意谎言第20章 祖孙商议
slug: 穿越大乾从病秧子开始蜕变
lines: “伪装？”老太君再次愣住。
“是。”方云逸目光坦然，“包括今日被那徐长老打伤，也是孙儿故意为之。
“孙儿运转秘法，制造出重伤濒死假象，就是为彻底洗脱嫌疑，避免玄云宗和朝廷的后续追查，引来不必要的麻烦。”
他话锋一转，带着一丝冷意。“至于那赵峰……不错，正是孙儿所杀。”
老太君倒吸一口凉气，虽然之前有所猜测，但亲耳听到孙儿承认，还是让她心神剧震。
她看着方云逸，眼神复杂无比，有担忧，有后怕，但更多的，是一种难以置信的审视。
杀人，伪装，承受武师境长老一掌而安然无恙……这真的是她那个病弱的孙儿能做到的吗？
“你……你如何能……”老太君的声音干涩，心中的疑问如同潮水般涌来。
她不知道眼前的这个孙儿，何时有了这等本事？他的毒是谁解的？他的武道从何而来？这一切都太过匪夷所思。
方云逸知道、祖母此刻心中定是带着无数个为什么，他早已准备好了说辞。
他不能暴露剑塔和穿越的秘密，那太过惊世骇俗，也可能会给祖母带来危险。
于是，一个被他虚拟出的“世外高人”形象被他适时地推了出来。
“祖母，您此刻心中的疑惑，孙儿明白。”方云逸语气带着恰到好处的恭敬与神秘。
“这一切，都要源于孙儿在八年前遇到的那位师傅。”
“师傅？”老太君喃喃道。
“是的。”
方云逸目光投向窗外的夜色，仿佛在回忆。“八年前，孙儿在藏书楼中昏迷之际，意识模糊中，在昏迷中遇到一位游历至此的世外高人。”
他看出孙儿身中奇毒，心生怜悯，便以无上秘法为孙儿压制毒性，并认为孙儿心志坚韧，是块可造之材，遂暗中收孙儿为徒，传授孙儿武道与医术。
他编造着细节，“师傅他老人家神龙见首不见尾，行踪飘忽不定，性情也有些古怪。”
他嘱咐孙儿绝不可对外人提及他的存在，孙儿身上的奇毒，正是师傅以秘法压制，还有武道，也是他老人家一手教导。
“师傅曾经说，孙儿体内的奇毒虽未除，但祸福相依，这些年在毒性磨砺……与他传授的特殊功法淬炼下，孙儿的根基反而比常人更为扎实。”
他回过眼神看向老太君，“祖母，逸儿如今不仅毒性暂控，武道修为亦小有所成，已有自保之力。”
您不必再日夜为孙儿的性命担忧，方家，不会就此而沉沦。
孙儿向您保证，终有一日，我会让方家重现昔日荣光，甚至……超越以往！
老太君听着孙儿的叙述，心中的震惊一波接着一波。世外高人？暗中收徒？
这一切听起来如同传奇话本，但看着孙儿那迥异于往昔的气度与眼神，感受着他话语中的坚定与力量，她又不得不信。
若非有如此奇遇，如何解释逸儿身上这天翻地覆的变化？又要如何解释他能悄无声息地杀掉赵峰，又能硬受徐长老一掌而无事？
content_en:
"Disguise?" The old lady was stunned again.
"Yes." Fang Yunyi's eyes were calm, "Including being injured by Elder Xu today, it was also intentional by his grandson.
"My grandson used secret techniques to create the illusion of being seriously injured and about to die, in order to completely remove suspicion and avoid unnecessary trouble from the Xuanyun Sect and the imperial court's follow-up investigation. "
He changed the topic with a hint of coldness. "As for Zhao Feng...yes, it was Sun Er who killed him. "
The old lady took a breath. Although she had guessed before, hearing her grandson admit it with her own ears still shocked her.
She looked at Fang Yunyi with extremely complicated eyes, including worry and fear, but more importantly, it was an unbelievable look.
Killing people, disguising themselves, enduring the palm of a martial arts elder without any harm... Is this really what her sickly grandson can do?
"You...how could you..." The old lady's voice was dry, and the questions in her heart came like a tide.
She didn't know when the grandson in front of her had such abilities. Who detoxified him? Where did his martial arts come from? This is all too incredible.
Fang Yunyi knew that his grandmother must have countless reasons in her heart at this moment, and he had already prepared his excuses.
He couldn't reveal the secrets of the sword tower and time travel. That would be too shocking and might also bring danger to his grandmother.
As a result, a virtual image of a "worldly master" was launched by him in a timely manner.
"Grandma, my grandson understands the doubts in your heart at this moment. "Fang Yunyi's tone was appropriately respectful and mysterious.
“All of this stems from the master that my grandson met eight years ago. "
"Master? "The old lady murmured.
"Yes. "
Fang Yunyi looked at the night outside the window, as if reminiscing. "Eight years ago, when my grandson was in a coma in the library, his consciousness was blurred. In his coma, he met a worldly master who had traveled here. "
Seeing that his grandson was poisoned by a strange poison, he felt pity for him, so he used the supreme secret method to suppress the poison for his grandson. He believed that his grandson had a strong mind and was a resource that could be made, so he secretly accepted his grandson as his disciple and taught him martial arts and medical skills.
He made up the details, "Master, this old man is a dragon that never comes to an end, his whereabouts are erratic, and his temperament is a little weird. "
He asked his grandson never to mention his existence to outsiders. The strange poison in his grandson was suppressed by the master with secret methods, and the martial arts were also taught by his old man.
"Master once said that although the strange poison in my grandson's body has not been eliminated, it is a blessing and a curse. Over the years, tempered by the poison... and tempered by the special skills he taught, my grandson's foundation is actually stronger than ordinary people. "
He turned back to look at the old lady, "Grandma, Yi'er is not only temporarily under control of his poison, but he has also made some progress in martial arts and is able to protect himself. "
You no longer have to worry about your grandson's life day and night, the Fang family will not sink into ruin.
My grandson promises you that one day, I will bring the Fang family back to its former glory, even...beyond the past!
The old lady was shocked one after another as she listened to her grandson's narration. An outsider? Secretly recruiting disciples?
All this sounds like a legendary story, but seeing her grandson's demeanor and eyes that were so different from the past, and feeling the firmness and strength in his words, she had to believe it.
If not for such an unexpected encounter, how could one explain the earth-shaking changes in Yi'er's body? How else to explain that he could kill Zhao Feng silently and endure a slap from Elder Xu without incident?
